# Synthetic clip catalogue fixtures

Every byte is generated by `generate.py` from invented values; no game file was
read or copied. Run `uv run python generate.py` in this directory to regenerate.

The DBA has two one-bone blocks at 24 fps with three keys each. `cycle.caf` moves
0 → 5 → 0 and `spare.caf` moves 0 → 4 → 8. Rotations are constant identities.
The chrparams maps only `latch_cycle` to the first block; the second is DBA-only.
The CAF wraps the same synthetic blocks with an AnimInfo chunk to exercise the
standalone parser. Tests assert full/sparse name and final-time parity, endpoint
boomerang classification and that intermediate values are not materialized.
